value.rationale: An extended fluctuating elastic interface can have exactly zero pairwise Fourier-amplitude correlations while all finite collections of its mode-energy fourth-order cross-covariances have strictly positive determinants. The exact energy-calibrated inverse extracts the global resetting clock from a pair of spectral modes without knowing temperature, a motivated diagnostics gap in non-Gaussian interface fluctuations. The sine/cosine degeneracy supplies the otherwise unavailable latent variance diagonal from one physical interface. This is more than numerical recomputation of a one-mode moment, although it does not assert finite-data stability.
